title: Permissions
description: Rich authoring schema for the permissions slice of @lifegames/copy (V2). Every Info.plist privacy-usage-description string the iOS app and watch present at permission-request time, keyed per-target (D6b): the app and watch targets intentionally use different wording (the watch omits app-only context). Each leaf is a CopyString carrying authoring context in _meta. Source of truth is ios-LifegamesPortal/LifePortal/project.yml (the NS*UsageDescription Info.plist properties on the LifePortal app target and the LifePortalWatch target). The copy build derives a FLAT schema from this one (stripping _meta) for all consumer codegen (TS/Zod/Swift). Strings are authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax (static passthrough — no interpolation here). Casing is natural-case (D3). The $defs block is byte-identical to schema/identity.schema.json, schema/widgets.schema.json, and schema/a11y.schema.json (per-file inlined, no cross-file $ref — §3.2).

health.title: PermHealth
health.description: NSHealthShareUsageDescription — shown when the app/watch requests HealthKit read access. The app variant adds 'to display metrics'; the watch variant only syncs.

locationWhenInUse.title: PermLocation
locationWhenInUse.description: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription — shown when the app/watch requests foreground location access. The app variant tracks movement history; the watch variant only displays current position.

locationAlways.title: PermLocationAlways
locationAlways.description: NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription — shown when the app requests background ('always') location access. App-only: the watch target has no always-on location usage description.

motion.title: PermMotion
motion.description: NSMotionUsageDescription — shown when the app requests Core Motion access for arrival/departure detection. App-only: the watch target has no motion usage description.
